text:
alex.k: FYI — runtime onboarding guide (docs/runtime/onboarding.md step 3) has a link to `s3://redwood-assets/guides/runtime-v1.tar.gz` that 404s in staging. Saw it from a quick smoke test.

maggie: can you paste the exact URL + error? I can check whether it's a rehost or just a bad shortlink.

alex.k: here you go:
```
$ curl -I https://s3.redwood-internal.com/guides/runtime-v1.tar.gz
HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found
x-request-id: abc-123
```
Looks like the object was rotated during last week's asset migration. I checked staging and there is `s3://redwood-assets/guides/runtime-2025-v2.tar.gz` which resolves.

sam: I can open a tiny PR to swap the link + update the checksum line. who should review? cc @maggie

maggie: thanks — if it's just a URL swap + one-line checksum update I can review. @docs-bot please mark as docs-hotfix?

docs-bot: Auto-detected: runbook link 404. Created issue #DOCS-4822. Reminder: add changelog entry: "fix: runtime onboarding asset link"

alex.k: thx. sam — go ahead. PR checklist:
- replace URL in docs/runtime/onboarding.md
- run `md5sum` on the new tarball and add checksum line
- smoke-test the updated guide in staging
I'll add a short note in the guide once deployed.

sam: GRAB. I'll open PR in ~30m and ping @maggie for review. Do we need to backport to ja translations as well?

maggie: yes please backport to `ja/` — ping the i18n owners after the PR. No urgent prod hotfix needed, staging-only for now.

alex.k: :thumbsup: @sam — lmk the PR link and I'll add the smoke-test result in the runbook.

sam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/12456 — small replace + `md5: b1946ac92492d2347`. @maggie please review when you have a sec.

maggie: Reviewing now.
